rebuttals.argument: This ruling describes customer behavior that aligns with our strategic objective to capture frustrated morning demand. The diversion of habitual Starbucks app users to competitor mobile apps, particularly those with $1 offers, directly supports the efficacy of our ongoing geo-targeted $1 Order Ahead app offer. The increased readiness of commuters to divert also plays into our drive-through convenience model.

We are continuing our commitment to allocate $15,000/month for incremental morning labor and $15,000/month for geo-targeted $1 Order Ahead app offers for new/lapsed users at our 12 shops near Starbucks pilot cafés. This aligns with our strategy to turn frustrated morning demand into repeat visits while protecting our service proposition, as supported by our capabilities and budget (d.dutch.d5, d.dutch.d6, d.dutch.d7).
